doc: Share of the variance lost by a 2x2 box average brought back bilinearly (rows clamp, columns wrap): the image is converted to float64 first, then every step is float64 (floor, clip, bilinear lerp, population variance), so a port is within 1e-9 (numpy against exactly rounded math.fsum sums: < 5e-16 relative). Bright first and last columns (1.0 and 0.6) in different 2x2 blocks: texels 0 and w - 1 blend the half-size columns hw - 1 and 0 across the antimeridian (x wraps, y clamps).
